verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration and hosting platform, so a browser-based tool playground or inspector is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only shows after-the-fact review of agent sessions and tool calls (the Agents area and traces) and connection URLs for external MCP clients. Neither lets a developer interactively exercise a server's tools in the browser before integrating, so these are adjacent observability features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it
